map.由气温与风速（km/h），按加拿大环境部 WCT 公式估算体感寒冷程度。: Estimate perceived cold from air temperature and wind speed (km/h) via the Environment Canada WCT formula.
map.低温有风时由气温与风速算体感风寒。: Perceived wind chill from temp and wind in cold windy conditions.
map.对比静风与大风下的体感差。: Compare perceived difference between calm and windy.
map.：同样 −10°C，风速 5→20 km/h，体感由约 −14°C 降到 −17: : Same −10°C, wind 5→20 km/h, perceived drops from ≈−14°C to −17.8°C; stronger wind sheds heat faster.
map.通常用于气温≤10°C 且风速>4.8 km/h，高温无风寒效应，反而用炎热指数: Usually for temp ≤10°C and wind >4.8 km/h; high heat has no wind-chill effect—use heat index instead.
map.体感越低皮肤降温越快，−18°C 以下暴露 30min 可冻伤，按风寒分级做户外: Lower perceived temp cools skin faster; below −18°C, 30-min exposure can frostbite—limit outdoor time by wind-chill grade.
